## Invitations

The outreach campaign issued 689 invitations. A total of 211 people attended, giving an attendance rate of 30.6 per cent. The figures provide a summary of invitations issued and attendance recorded during the reporting period. Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring, which should be considered when reviewing participation across the year.

## Contact

Of the invitations issued, 597 were sent with an SMS. A reminder message was also sent to 597 people. This contact activity supported the invitation process and provided recipients with an additional prompt ahead of attendance.

The report was prepared by G. Evans.
